title: 9 o’clock Nasty's album ‘This Is Crowland’ is a willful, darkly hilarious rock revolution
htmlContent: 9 o’clock Nasty is back with an explosive new album titled This Is Crowland, making a bold statement against the chaotic times of 2025. With 15 songs packed into just under 40 minutes, this album offers an intense listening experience that’s anything but boring. It’s a wild ride through the craziness of modern life. The album is set in Crowland, a chaotic and mysterious place the band uses as a playground. They deliver sharp humor and a rebellious attitude, creating songs that inspire you to dance, shout, and challenge the status quo all at once. From the powerful title track “Crowland” to the energetic “The Wrong Guy,” 9 o’clock Nasty blends raw excitement with a playful twist, showing that even in tough times, there’s always a reason to have fun and be bold. https://open.spotify.com/album/0C8sqeSzRaNcoHoo6K7N57 Their music mixes punk energy with catchy beats, representing the struggle between freedom and control in today’s world. “This album is about standing up for yourself,” the band explains. “It’s about rejecting nonsense and strutting confidently even when things feel dark.” 9 o’clock Nasty encourages you to laugh in the face of challenges, embrace the chaos, and take charge of your story.
